question: In which year was the Foreign Investment Board established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1991**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Foreign Investment Board was established in the year **1991**.
 
• The board was set up to facilitate foreign investment in India and to ensure that such investments align with the country's economic policies and priorities.
 
• It plays a crucial role in reviewing and recommending proposals for foreign investments, ensuring that they contribute positively to the Indian economy.
 
• The board evaluates various factors such as the sector of investment, its impact on local industries, employment generation, and technological advancement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The establishment of the Foreign Investment Board marked a significant step in India's economic liberalization process.
 
• It aimed at creating a more investor-friendly environment to attract foreign capital, which is essential for economic growth and development.
 
• Over the years, the policies and procedures of the board have been refined to adapt to the changing global economic landscape.
 
• The board works in conjunction with other governmental bodies to streamline the investment process and address any concerns that may arise.
